app_store_url.description: App Store listing URL opened by the update dialog on iOS.

base_url.description: API base URL override. Must end with /api/. App falls back to the compiled default when empty.

defaultValue.value: A new version is available. Please update to continue.

update_message.description: Message shown on the force-update dialog.

play_store_url.description: Play Store listing URL opened by the update dialog on Android.

force_update.description: When true, users below the minimum version/build are forced to update.

show_loans.description: Set to true to show the Loans & Expenses tile on the Quick Actions screen. Hidden by default.

show_air_tickets.description: Set to true to show the Air Tickets tile on the Quick Actions screen. Hidden by default.
